propositions: AGENTS.md unconditionally prefers symbol tools over grep but this rule is false when symbols are named as string literals (monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib) which LSP cannot resolve
LSP string-literal blind spot caused agents following the current rule exclusively to miss call sites in string literals, contributing to failed test discovery in epic 061c story S1
LSP index can lag behind recent edits in the working tree, reporting stale line numbers
AGENTS.md must replace the bare preference with a decision table dividing labour by use case: symbol references use LSP, string-named symbols use grep, current line numbers use grep on working tree
Documentation must explicitly name the string-literal blind spot and stale-index caveat with concrete examples to make the rule trustworthy
